note: Track breath, step 6 (a long breath out): one breathwork circle with the "long-exhale" drill at its own lengths (in for 4, out for 8); the text follows the circle, names the control that runs it again, and the feel to reach is an even flow to the end of the breath. The advanced block of this drill stays separate, because its breathwork is set longer and a choice can't change a tool's seconds.

exercise.title: A long breath out
exercise.why: A long phrase is one slow breath out, so a breath out twice as long as the breath in is the phrase without its notes.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Breathe in while the circle grows, then let the air out slowly until it is small again.
When the rounds are done, press Again in the circle to run them once more.
Practice until the air flows as evenly at the end of the breath out as at the start.
